basic_profile.bio: Based in Appleton, I'm a 44-year-old freelance financial advisor with a passion for helping others navigate the complexities of personal finance. I love collecting unique hats from my travels and enjoy weekend drives exploring the countryside. I'm married with two kids and spend my evenings diving into the latest Demon Slayer manga chapters. My typical online hours are during the late evening, after the kids are asleep, and on weekends when I'm not meeting clients.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a degree in Finance from the University of Wisconsin and over 15 years of experience in the financial advisory field. I keep myself updated with the latest tax laws and investment strategies through continuous learning and professional development courses.
